video.title: AI欧腐《女装替嫁掰弯了黑帮教父/Bent by My Sister's Mafia Husband》
video.desc:
Intern doctor Casbin cross-dresses to marry mob boss Hawk to save his sister — then learns Hawk despises liars and gay men. Hiding the truth through wedding nights, Casbin slowly falls for the don. But when Hawk finds out his bride is a man — the very stranger who saved his life — will he pull the trigger, or break every rule for love?
实习医生 Casbin 为了救姐姐，女装替嫁给了黑帮老大 Hawk——婚后才得知，Hawk 最痛恨的就是骗子和同性恋。新婚之夜一次次瞒天过海，Casbin 却渐渐对这位教父动了心。而当 Hawk 发现自己的新娘是个男人——还是当年救过他一命的那个陌生人——他会扣下扳机，还是为了爱打破所有规矩？
